outcome: Success rate of external cephalic version
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent external cephalic version
finding: Multiparity, transverse lie, unengaged breech presentation, low body mass index, soft uterus and palpable fetal head were independent risk factors for successful external cephalic version.
mod_finding: Routine use of ECV allowed a reduction in cesarean delivery rates for breech presentation, with no increase in maternal or neonatal morbidity.
